ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT by and between 10EAST34TH,LLC and CAERUSGROUP4E34LLC Dated as of: April 26, 2018 BLOCK: 863 LOTS: 75 and 80 New York, New York RECORD AND RETURN TO: SEIDEN&SCHEIN,P.C. 570LEXINGTONAVENUE,14THFLOOR NEW YORK, NEW YORK 10022

THIS ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Owner"), having an address at c/o Caerus Group, 200 East 58th Street, New York, New York 10022,and CAERUS GROUP 4E34 LLC,a East58thStreet,NewYork,NewYork10022. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,located in the Borough of Manhattan,City,County and State of New York,known as Lot 75in Block 863on the TaxMap of the City of NewYork,County of New York, and as and by the street address 10 East 34th Street, New York, New York, and more Land"; the building and improvements located thereon are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the "OwnerParcel"); WHEREAS, Owner previously entered into that certain ZoningLot Development and Easement Agreement ("1-33 Street ZLDA"),on March 14, 2016, with Rosen, Gluck & May ("Rosen"), the owner, of that certain property known as Lot 6 in Block 863 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,County of NewYork,and as and by the street address 1 East 33rd Street, New York, New York ("Rosen Parcel"), to create a merged zoning lot with Owner Parcel and Rosen Parcel, by utilizing the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the merged zoning lot, so as to make available the right to include the Rosen Parcel in calculating Bonus Floor Area Development Rights(the“Rosen Subject Floor Area Development Rights") for utilization in connectionwith the construction andmaintenance of the OwnerBuilding,and to make suchRosenSubject Floor AreaDevelopment Rights available to Owner in perpetuity; WHEREAS,at the time Owner entered into the1-33StreetZLDA,Owner also entered into that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions ("Rosen Declaration"),on March 14, 2016, with Rosen, in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term "zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, in order to create a single zoning lot of  the Rosen Parcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Rosen Declaration and the terms of the 1-33 Street ZLDA, is herein referred to a s the“Merged Developer Zoning Lot"); WHEREAS, the 1-33 Street ZLDA permits the inclusion of additional parcels into the Merged Developer Zoning Lot; WHEREAS,Owner wishes to include the Developer Parcel (as hereinafter defined) with the Merged Developer Zoning Lot, so as to make available the Transferred Excess Development Rights (as defined below) for utilization in connection with the construction and 2
